evidence.notes: Run on these exact bytes (the draft's DMG, sha256 f0bdd694..., downloaded from the draft (release 442019286) with gh into a fresh folder and hash-checked, the draft's digests of the DMG and the zip read back and matching, copied into a fresh clone of tahoe-base and given Safari's quarantine flag), 11 Nov, clean macOS 26.6.2 (no Marver, no ~/.marver before): the DMG opened and mounted (Marver 1.2.0); Marver double-clicked in its window - the disk-image question ('Safari downloaded this disk image today... Apple checked it for malicious software and none was detected'), Open; the silent move (/Applications/Marver.app there before the second answer; app.jsonl: update move moved 1.2.0; update.json's move already cleared as read, the one-time 'Moved to Applications' note being a 4 s pill, not seen on screen); macOS's second question ('downloaded on an unknown date. Apple checked it...'), Open; Home, the new 1.2 empty state: 'No canvas running yet' with its three cards (In a repo with Marver: npx marver dev; A repo without Marver yet: npm i -D @marver-design/marver && npx marver init; A canvas someone shared with you: Open a canvas link), screenshot vm/shots/s7-120-4-home.png; running from /Applications/Marver.app (not translocated: no AppTranslocation process); spctl: accepted, Notarized Developer ID, Developer ID Application: Nicolas Touron (PXV6WER853); codesign design.marver.app, team PXV6WER853; version 1.2.0 (CFBundleShortVersionString and CFBundleVersion; app.jsonl start: release flavour, electron 45.0.0); launch none-restored; the update check answered current. The 1.1 items again on these bytes: app-live.json written (scheme 1, version 1.2.0), LaunchServices resolves marver: to /Applications/Marver.app, and a marver://open?ws=<a folder> link opened in the VM reached the app (app.jsonl: cmd deep-link done) and, with no canvas running, showed Home's board with that folder's card under Not running, its menu open with Copy start command first (vm/shots/s7-120-5-link.png); a bare marver://show was refused as bad, as designed. NOT re-run by hand on 1.2.0: notice-ask, notice-banner, dock-badge, notice-denied, settings-link, signin, shared-card, live-picture - carried over from Nic's hand checks of 0.3.0 on 31 Oct (#53), as for 1.0.0, 1.0.1 and 1.1.0 by Nic's decision; 1.2 does not touch the notices or sign-in (it changes Home, the tab strip and Hide UI in play). google 'refused': not shown to work, unchanged (#53 finding 2); not retried.
